interactions.title: Read cabin crew service guide
pages: Before boarding: check the cabin and assigned service stations. Confirm crew positions and prepare the passenger service area.
Before taxi: secure service carts and loose equipment. Follow the captain and cabin crew instructions.
During service: check the aisle before moving a cart, keep hot items secured and respond to passenger calls.
Before landing: clear service items, stow equipment and report cabin status.
